21:25.text: And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

21:26.text: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they

21:27.text: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.

21:29.text: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.

21:30.text: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?

21:31.text: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein
roads that they might be guided.

21:34.text: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity

21:35.text: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
